A letter, just for you

A little old-fashioned note, because some feelings deserve paper.

My dearest Shagun,

A note for your birthday

Happy birthday, Shagun. I hope this new chapter brings you gentle mornings, unexpected happiness, peaceful days, and a thousand little reasons to smile. Thank you for being you — for the memories, the laughter, the little moments, and for making ordinary days feel special. I may not always find the perfect words, but I hope you never doubt how much you mean to me. May every beautiful wish your heart holds find its way to you. Keep smiling, keep shining, and never forget how special you are. Today, and on all the ordinary days after it, I hope life is kind to you.

With all my love, ♡
one last little wish…

May life be as lovely
as your heart.

More smiles, more magic, more moments worth remembering.

♥

MADE WITH LOVE · JUST FOR SHAGUN
a wish for you

Keep shining, Shagun.

If I could wrap up all the good things in the world and give them to you, I would. Until then, here's a little reminder: you are loved, you are precious, and you deserve beautiful things.
